about.title: About Red Phoenix
about.intro: A supply chain and execution partner headquartered in both China and Syria, turning sourcing and logistics into finished projects on the ground.
about.methodologyDesc: From raw origin points to execution on the ground, structured precisely at every single milestone.

sourcing.title: Sourcing
sourcing.text: We find and vet manufacturers and suppliers in China for your exact specification and budget.

planning.title: Planning
planning.text: Scope, schedules, shipping and site requirements are planned before anything leaves the factory.

supplying.title: Supplying
supplying.text: We manage procurement, quality checks and delivery from China to your site in Syria.

executing.title: Executing
executing.text: Our teams on the ground handle installation and fit-out through to handover.

about.valuesSubtitle: The principles behind every project, regardless of sector.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.text: We commit to realistic timelines and hold to them, so your project stays on schedule.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: You always know the status of your order, your shipment, and your budget.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We work as an extension of your team, not just a vendor filling an order.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.text: From equipment selection to final installation, the details are handled with care.

about.officesTitle: On the ground in both countries
about.chinaOfficeNote: Sourcing, factory relationships and quality control.
about.syriaOfficeNote: Site execution, installation and client relationships.

raw-materials.title: Raw Materials Sourcing

industrial-heavy-equipment.title: Industrial Heavy Equipment & Machinery
industrial-heavy-equipment.description: High-performance production lines, manufacturing machinery, and heavy industrial gear inspected and shipped securely.

electronics.title: Electronics & Smart Technology

whyChooseUs.title: Why partners choose Red Phoenix
whyChooseUs.subtitle: A single accountable partner for the whole journey — not a factory contact on one end and a local contractor on the other.

onGround.title: Teams on the ground
onGround.text: Bilingual staff in China and Syria mean nothing gets lost between the factory and the finished site.

qualityControl.title: Quality control, verified
qualityControl.text: Suppliers are vetted and inspected before goods ship, not discovered after they arrive.

singleContact.title: One point of contact
singleContact.text: You deal with one project lead from sourcing through handover, not a different name at every stage.

transparentProcess.title: A transparent process
transparentProcess.text: Clear milestones for sourcing, planning, supply and execution, so you always know where your project stands.

testimonial.quote: Red Phoenix managed our fit-out from the factory floor to final installation without us needing a local contractor at all.

ctaBand.title: Have a project in mind?
ctaBand.text: Tell us what you're building and we'll put together a scope and quote.

leadTime.q: How long does a typical project take?
leadTime.a: It depends on scope and sector — a single equipment order moves faster than a full venue build-out. We give you a realistic timeline once we understand your project.

customs.a: We manage logistics and customs coordination from the Chinese factory to your site in Syria, so you are not dealing with freight forwarders directly.

projectSize.q: Is there a minimum project size?
projectSize.a: We take on everything from a single equipment order to a full venue or facility build.

afterSales.a: We remain your point of contact for warranty issues, spare parts and follow-on equipment orders.

payment.a: Projects are typically billed against agreed milestones — sourcing, shipment and installation — rather than a single upfront payment.
